levels.title: Runner Test 01 — Basic Chain
levels.blurb: The floor of the language: jump, run, jump. Everything else is a variation on this.

levels.title: Runner Test 02 — Short Short Long
levels.blurb: Two taps and a full hold. The phrase rhythm has to read as one gesture, not three jumps.

levels.title: Runner Test 03 — Staircase
levels.blurb: Four risers up, four back down. Every tread has to be landable and re-launchable.

levels.title: Runner Test 04 — High Low
levels.blurb: Land high, land low, four times. The vertical read is the whole phrase.

levels.title: Runner Test 05 — Gap Chain
levels.blurb: Holes in the track, back to back. Each one near the limit of what the arc carries.

levels.title: Runner Test 06 — Drop And Jump
levels.blurb: Climb, walk off the ledge, and leave again the moment you land.

levels.title: Runner Test 07 — Gravity Flip
levels.blurb: The world turns over and back. The flip is a snap, not a flight.

levels.title: Runner Test 08 — Inverted Chain
levels.blurb: A whole phrase spent on the ceiling, with slabs hanging into the route.

levels.title: Runner Test 09 — Vertical Corridor
levels.blurb: A walkway with a roof over it. The jump inside has to fit the headroom.

levels.title: Runner Test 10 — Dense Phrase
levels.blurb: Hops on the half-beat. The densest thing the mode can ask for without becoming noise.

levels.title: Runner Test 11 — Mixed Showcase
levels.blurb: One phrase from every family, back to back. The integration smoke test.

levels.title: Arena Practice
levels.blurb: Dodge. Floor warnings, chains and projectiles.

levels.title: Runner Practice
levels.blurb: Jump and slide. Spikes, low walls and bounce pads.

levels.title: Runner Showcase
levels.blurb: A 60s handcrafted course: chains, staircases, gaps, a gravity flip, a corridor and a climax.

levels.title: Vertical Practice
levels.blurb: Four falling lanes. Hit D F J K on the line.

levels.title: Radial Practice
levels.blurb: Four directions converging on the centre ring.

levels.title: Arena Showcase
levels.blurb: Every ARENA mechanic, including safe tiles and lasers.

levels.title: Prototype 90s
levels.blurb: The full multi-mode song map: all four modes and their transitions.

levels.title: Runner Test 12 — Double Jump
levels.blurb: Isolates DOUBLE_JUMP_MOUNT: a block above single-jump reach, mounted by jumping again at the mid-air ring.

levels.title: Runner Test 13 — Sky Steps
levels.blurb: Isolates SKY_STEPS: floating blocks over holes, one full jump apart -- miss the beat, take the fall.
